title: Layered Route

story.briefing: The last corridor is blocked, but the crew carries charges. Each charge clears one obstruction. Find the shortest walk to the exit given how many charges you hold.
story.success: Route cleared with charges to spare. The way to the Core stands open.

description: Given a grid of 0 (open) and 1 (blocked) and a number of charges k, return the fewest steps from the top-left cell to the bottom-right cell, moving up, down, left or right. Entering a blocked cell consumes one charge, and you may not enter one with no charges left. The starting cell never needs a charge. Return -1 if the exit cannot be reached.

examples.explanation: One charge clears one blocked cell.

hints: Arriving at a cell is no longer one situation. Arriving with three charges left is genuinely different from arriving with none, and the two must be tracked separately.
Add the charges remaining as a third dimension to your visited marker. Without it, an early wasteful route blocks a later thrifty one that would have reached further.

Run a breadth-first search over states of cell plus charges remaining. Moving into an open cell keeps the count; moving into a blocked cell spends one and is forbidden at zero. The first arrival at the exit in any state is the answer.
